title: 上海高考翻译背诵-78-25一模普陀

items.zh: 接到电话说航班已取消,她立刻出发去了火车站。
items.en: Having been informed that the flight had been cancelled, she rushed to the train station immediately.

items.zh: 别担心淋雨,是时候试试你的新外套是否防雨了。
items.en: Don’t worry about getting caught in the rain. It’s time to test whether your new coat is waterproof.

items.zh: 这座几经战乱的城堡俯瞰这座城市,见证了它在过去五百年的兴衰。
items.en: The castle, having weathered many wars, overlooks the city and has witnessed its rise and fall over the past five hundred years.

items.zh: 这家百年老店吸纳了多国美食烹任方法, 又自成一派, 食客可以在舌尖感受异国文化。
items.en: The century-old restaurant has incorporated culinary techniques from multiple countries and developed its own unique style, where diners can savor exotic culture.
